note: Audio seconds are decoded payload bytes / 48000. Connection seconds are measured session wall-clock, reported separately and never used as an audio estimate.

windows.name: probe-close
windows.design: 10 sessions send a 0.72s clip and close at once; 5 connect and close sending nothing
windows.verdict: not discriminating: audio and connection land on the same number

windows.name: idle-heavy
windows.design: 4 bulk sends closed without a silence tail (never committed) + 4 sessions held open 60s with zero audio
windows.verdict: 240s of connection time carrying no audio at all

windows.name: audio-heavy
windows.design: 8 sessions each send 30.5s of audio, wait for input_audio_buffer.committed, close
windows.verdict: all 8 committed: the server ingested every second of it

how_to_read.console_delta_near_290s_concentrated_in_: metered on connection time, which explains the 66,000s
how_to_read.console_delta_far_larger: metered on something else again; neither quantity accounts for it

server_acknowledgement: input_audio_buffer.speech_started -> speech_stopped -> committed observed, so appended audio is genuinely ingested
